classification.rule: All six identities, isolated actions, identical fresh baselines, opposite signed joint deltas, opposite axis-projected rotations, and opposing endpoint displacement dot products must pass. Anatomical neural sign remains unresolved because labels alone are insufficient.

environment.expected: validated FlyGym position-control fly compiled by MuJoCo
environment.versions: record installed FlyGym, MuJoCo, and NumPy versions at execution; do not adapt protocol by version

identity_checks: unique compiled actuator and joint names
actuator transmission targets the same compiled joint
unique annotation-backed anterior/posterior population pair per joint
mechanical_measurements: joint qpos before and after displacement
compiled local joint axis and measured baseline world joint axis
owning-segment baseline and perturbed orientation matrices
signed relative rotation projected onto measured world joint axis
distal Tarsus5 baseline and perturbed world position
overwrite_protection: attempt and result use exclusive-create semantics; either existing path refuses execution
reset_policy: Construct and reset a fresh independent FlyGym/MuJoCo simulation for each sign of each joint; require byte-derived baseline state identities to match within each +/- pair.
sign_resolution_algorithm: For each displacement, derive relative owning-segment rotation from measured matrices and project its signed axis-angle onto the measured neutral world joint axis. Require positive/negative projections and qpos deltas to oppose, and require the dot product of distal endpoint displacement vectors to be negative. This resolves mechanical coordinate direction only.
zero_physics_step_policy: Use qpos displacement followed by kinematic mj_forward only; execute zero time-advancing physics transitions.
